Is anyone else having issues with Opera? Every time I open a Veuwer link I get a "Fatal Error (80)" from the server.

I've disabled firewall, restarted browser, etc. Every time it is the same error. The website works just fine in Chrome/Firefox.

I'm running version 12.16 Opera.

Basic explanation: That's an old version of Opera and it doesn't support the algorithms being used for https on Veuwer.

More complicated explanation: Veuwer uses TLS 1.2, which your version of Opera does support, but it's disabled by default. If you click the menu in the top-left, go to Settings → Preferences → Security → Security Protocols, then check TLS 1.2, you can refresh and get "Fatal Error (40)" instead of 80. Now it seems that error is because encryption is being done with AES_128_GCM, which Opera 12.16 doesn't support at all.

So you need to upgrade your browser. I'm going to guess you're using 12.16 because you don't want to use WebKit/Blink, but Veuwer works fine on Opera 31. It might be worth a try, see if you like it now.
Thanks, it was the version I was using. I updated the browser and it works perfectly.
